verdict.rationale: ChatGPT documents scheduled and event-triggered automations, and lets users review active, paused, and completed tasks and their recent runs. That is run monitoring, not versioning automation definitions, reviewing changes to them, or rolling back to a prior version. No evidence shows automation version history or rollback, so the axis applies but is unsupported.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
